logp.method_description: The octanol-water distribution coefficient of RuPS was determined using the shake-flask method. Phosphate buffer aqueous solutions of RuPS at pH 7.4 were mixed with n-octanol in flasks. Both solvents were previously saturated with one other at room temperature. A concentration of 16 μM of RuPS was employed, while three different volume ratios between buffered solution and n-octanol (Vw/Vn-Oct) were used, varying from 1:0.5 to 1:2. The heterogeneous mixtures were allowed to equilibrate overnight by flasks shaking, and then the two phases were separated by centrifugation at 4000 rpm for 4 min at 25°C. Subsequently, the concentrations of the ruthenium compound in the organic n-octanol phases of all the three samples were determined spectrophotometrically, while those in the aqueous phases were obtained by difference. The logD7.4 value was calculated as the mean value of the values obtained from the three samples using the following equation: log D7.4 = log([RuPS]n-Oct / [RuPS]w) = log((mo × Vw) / (mw × Vn-Oct)) where [RuPS]n-Oct and [RuPS]w represent the total concentration of the compound in the organic and in the aqueous phases, respectively. The term m denotes the mass of RuPS present in the aqueous (w) or in the organic (n-Oct) phase, and V denotes the volume of each phase.
